title: An ALMA spectroscopic survey of the Planck high-redshift object PLCK G073.4−57.5 confirms two protoclusters
question: What is the redshift distribution of the galaxies in the Planck-selected field G073, are the two suspected structures (z~1.5 and z~2) real protoclusters, and what are their gas and star-formation properties?

data.bands: Band 4 (2.1 mm; Cycle 6) plus Band 6 (1.3 mm; Cycle 2, from Kneissl+19)
data.angular_resolution: about 0.65'' x 0.55'' (LSB) and 0.58'' x 0.50'' (USB), natural weighting
data.sensitivity: continuum 15–20 uJy/beam in each of 12 pointings

what.value: Cycle 2 Band 6 continuum detections of 18 galaxies, positions, photometric redshifts, de-blended SPIRE fluxes, NIR/MIR photometry

evidence.quote: These observations are presented in detail in (cite: kneissl19)
(again within the Planck beam; see (cite: mackenzie2017))

evidence.loc: 6.1 The large-scale structure probed by G073
evidence.quote: (cite: gouin2022) compared the $z\,{\approx}\,1.5$ and $z\,{\approx}\,2$ structures in G073 to the (300 Mpc)$^3$ TNG300 simulation

what.value: CI/CO gas mass calibration alpha_CI/alpha_CO = 5.2±1.3 and r31, r41 ratios

evidence.quote: finding an average $\alpha_\mathrm{CI}/\alpha_\mathrm{CO}$ of 5.2$\,{\pm}\,$1.3, which we used here.

evidence.quote: for example $\alpha_{\rm CO}=4.36$ in (cite: noble17), (cite: noble19), and (cite: rudnick17) and $\alpha_{\rm CO}=0.8$ in (cite: ivison13)

recipe.method: LineSeeker on primary-beam-uncorrected LSB and USB cubes with Gaussian spectral convolution; cutoff set from most significant negative peak (S/N 6.1)
Noise-weighted mean continuum maps per pointing; threshold equal to the largest negative peak (S/N 5.1)

recipe.goal: Extract spectra and measure lines and continuum
recipe.method: Elliptical apertures from the 2 sigma contours; continuum subtraction with imcontsub; single Gaussian fits; line flux summed over ±3 sigma; L' per Solomon+97; continuum from line-free channels with S/N>2
Likelihood ratio test for CO(3-2)+CI vs single line, threshold 0.05; chi2 SED fit for ID 24; ID 4 assumed at ID 3 redshift
assumptions: only two redshift possibilities (z~1.5 and z~2.3) for non-SCUBA-2 lines

recipe.method: CIGALE SED fitting (delayed SFH with burst, BC03, Draine14 dust, Calzetti attenuation, solar metallicity); SFR_IR from cmcirsed modified blackbody with Kennicutt&Evans relation
M_gas = alpha_CO L'CO(1-0) with CO(3-2) and CO(4-3) converted via r31=0.60 and r41=0.32; CI mass using alpha_CI = 5.2 alpha_CO
assumptions: same alpha_CO for all sources regardless of MS classification

recipe.goal: Compare gas properties to field and cluster samples and to TNG300
recipe.method: Compute depletion time and gas-to-stellar ratio, MS offsets (Popesso+23), scaling relations of Liu+19 and Sargent+14, update Gouin+22 simulation comparison with spectroscopic redshifts
